android-content|Avatar.summary: A Plenix avatar on Android is a small composable (a ShapeableImageView or a TextView in Views), since Material 3 has no avatar component: a person’s picture or initials in a rounded square, never a circle, with the corner and the text size following the size. Initials are DM Sans bold in the avatar colors; a person’s own color uses its soft fill and text color; a category uses its category color. It is hidden from TalkBack unless it carries a label. Material’s lists show a 40 dp circle; Plenix keeps the list placement and replaces the shape and colors.
